text: MOA Sport, the company behind the Nalini cycling-apparel brand, was founded in 1970 by Claudio Mantovani together with his brother Vincenzo and remains their company (MOA Sport Mantovani Vincenzo Srl, Castel d'Ario, Italy).

source.name: MOA Sport: Welcome to MOA Sport (company page)
source.quote: Welcoming you and shaking your hand will be the patron of MOA Sport, Claudio Mantovani, who, with his brother Vincenzo, founded in 1970 this production hub

additionalSources.name: Nalini: Cycling clothing online shop (homepage)
additionalSources.quote: All Nalini garments are developed in Italy by Moa Sport which presides over every phase of the process: from the design and from the spinning and processing of the fabrics to the finished garment.
additionalSources.note: The Nalini brand site's footer also credits 'MOA SPORT MANTOVANI VINCENZO SRL - P.I. 01335840201'.
